entries.summary: The embedded server's SQLite file is now schema 8 (#1113 A2b): the activity log is persisted in the database instead of process memory, so task activity and its cursors survive a restart, and the terminal-task archive removes it in its own transaction. A schema 6 or 7 file is upgraded in place when it opens, inside the open transaction, keeping its pairings, tasks, approvals and other rows; 7 to 8 adds activity_log_head and activity_log_entry empty, since no activity history was persisted before. The upgrade is one-way: 0.32.0 and earlier refuse a schema 8 file, so stop the server and back up the database file before the first open with this release. Schema 8 also closes a task's activity log and approval timeline in the same transaction as its first terminal or accepted Host cancellation (#1113 A3); the 7 to 8 upgrade rebuilds approval_timeline_tail without the idle deadline, keeping every observation, and closes already-closed tasks at their original deadline. A v8 file missing either activity table or the closure trigger is refused as SQLITE_SCHEMA_INVALID.

An approval timeline no longer idle-expires (#1113 A3). It closes in the same transaction as its task's first terminal or accepted Host cancellation and expires ten minutes after that instant; reads and replays never renew it. ApprovalTimelineAppendInput loses ttlMs, and ApprovalTimelineTail gains terminalAt while its expiresAt becomes optional, present only once closed. On a closed timeline ApprovalTimelineStore.append throws the new approval_timeline_settled code and resolvePending returns absent, so a request pending at the close can no longer be decided; ByokCloud refuses a late task.await_approval with task_settled_by_cloud. A timeline keeps at most 50 observations and MAX_APPROVAL_TIMELINE_BYTES (1 MiB) of serialized observations, evicting the oldest first and never the pending request; one event is at most MAX_APPROVAL_EVENT_BYTES and capacity must be 2 to 50, else coordination_input_invalid. Archive, redaction and expiry clear a closed timeline's entries and keep its row as the fence. A custom ApprovalTimelineStore must close with its task, refuse appends once closed, and retain through retainApprovalObservations or the same bounds; pendingApprovalObservation is the shared pending fold.

A task's activity log and approval timeline close in the same transaction as its first terminal or accepted Host cancellation, in every built-in composition (#1113 A3). Later task.progress, task.artifact and task.await_approval are refused with task_settled_by_cloud, also on a redacted or archived task, and both expire ten minutes after the closing instant without renewal. CLOUD_ERROR_CODES gains approval_timeline_settled. The in-memory InMemoryTaskAttemptStore, InMemoryTaskCancellationStore and InMemoryDeviceDirectory close them through the attempt state, and a custom composition must close both in the same commit as its first terminal or accepted cancellation. Postgres migration 0035 adds the closing trigger on task and approval_timeline_tail.terminal_at with a constraint that only a closed row has expires_at, drops the idle deadline of every open timeline, and closes already-closed tasks at their original deadline. Deploy 0035 and the code together: each fails against the other's approval schema. Apply 0035 only through deploy/scripts/migrate, and on a large tenant in a maintenance window: it scans task and rewrites approval_timeline_tail in one transaction that blocks writes to task.
